name: indesign-mcp
description: Create and edit InDesign documents (IDML) with Claude: pages, master pages, styles, text, tables, pictures and AI-generated images, with page previews before you open the file in InDesign. Community project, not affiliated with Adobe.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Only needed to generate or edit pictures with OpenAI. Leave empty to turn image generation off. OpenAI bills each picture to this key.

documents_dir.title: Documents folder (optional)
documents_dir.description: Where documents given by bare file name are saved. Empty means ~/Documents/InDesign MCP.

references_dir.title: Reference documents folder (optional)
references_dir.description: A folder with your own .idml exports that Claude may borrow styles, colours and master pages from.

default_unit.title: Default unit
default_unit.description: Unit for measurements given as bare numbers: mm (default), cm, in or pt.

image_model.title: OpenAI image model
image_model.description: OpenAI model used by generate_image and edit_image: gpt-image-2 (default), gpt-image-1.5 or gpt-image-1-mini.
